### Automated observation — GuitarAlchemist/gaia issue #117 adds durable conflict-claim slice

- **Observed at:** 2026-09-05T01:29:12Z
- **Repository / subject:** GuitarAlchemist/gaia issue #117 (`feat: turn PR conflict escalations into durable pump claims`)
- **Observation:** A new OPEN+needs-triage P1 design slice was created to turn an authoritatively observed conflicting PR generation into one durable, generation-bound claim instead of leaving conflict as dashboard-only escalation. The contract keys ownership to exact repository/PR/base/head identity, requires one append/CAS linearization point, typed stale-loser/duplicate no-effect behavior, crash recovery, and operation-identity reconciliation after ambiguous dispatch.
- **Authority boundary:** The slice authorizes only a durable claim plus bounded escalation receipt. It explicitly grants no merge, force-push, blanket conflict strategy, credential, workflow, permission, or automatic file-edit authority. No implementation PR exists yet.
- **Interpretation:** `NEW GAIA CONFLICT-RECOVERY ROADMAP / NEEDS-TRIAGE DESIGN P1 / DURABLE CLAIM CONTRACT DEFINED / NO IMPLEMENTATION START / NO AUTHORITY WIDENING`.
- **Recommended next action:** Admit only after one exact owner, current-code evidence, prerequisites and spend cap are bound; then use a normal linked Draft PR for the smallest claim/dispatch tracer. Do not dispatch or mutate GitHub merely from issue creation.
- **Automation note:** No repository mutation was performed except appending this observation comment.
